meta.name: lifecycle-play-advisor
meta.description: Diagnose where a product sits in its lifecycle and which play fits — extend, replace, or retire. Use when a product is fading and you need the call, not just the worry.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 判断产品所处生命周期阶段，给出扩展、替换或退市的决策建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正为一个增长停滞的产品犹豫该投入改造还是退出。
copy.tagline_en: Decide your product lifecycle play: extend, replace, or retire.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are deciding whether to keep investing in a fading product or let it go.

howto.what: 装上后,当你说某个产品在走下坡路时,Claude 会先问最多四个问题,判断它处于生命周期哪个阶段、压力来自哪里,再给出「延展、替换、退场」或「暂不行动/收割」的建议,并说明理由、风险,以及后续可用的其他技能。
howto.when: 当你描述某个产品增长停滞或被认为在衰退,并想判断该延展、替换还是退场时触发。例如提到营收持平、支持成本上升,或领导层想砍掉某产品。

say.text: 我们的报表模块连续六个季度持平,该延展、替换还是退场?
say.note: Claude 会按四步提问并给出诊断和推荐。

say.text: 领导层想砍掉零件模块,帮我们判断这样对不对。
say.note: Claude 会先确认触发来源,再测生命周期阶段。

say.text: 某产品收入平平,但渠道可能有问题,该怎么查?
say.note: Claude 会用七问判定阶段,并区分渠道问题和产品问题。

howto.what_en: After installation, when you say a product is fading, Claude runs up to four diagnostic questions to place its lifecycle stage and find the real pressure source, then recommends extend, replace, retire, harvest, or nothing yet — with reasoning, hazards, and a route to the executing skill.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you describe a product that is stalling or fading and want the call among extend, replace, or retire — e.g., flat revenue, rising support cost, or leadership wanting to kill it.

say_en.text: Our reporting module has been flat six quarters. Extend, replace, or retire?
say_en.note: Claude runs the four questions and gives a diagnosis.

say_en.text: Leadership wants to kill the parts module. Walk us through whether that's right.
say_en.note: Claude checks the trigger first, then the lifecycle stage.

say_en.text: Revenue is flat but the channel may be broken. How do we tell?
say_en.note: Claude uses the seven reads to separate channel issues from product issues.
